system_description.narrative_title: Ukraine's strikes on Russian energy and the widening geopolitical-economic fallout
system_description.narrative_summary: The dominant story is Ukraine increasingly targeting Russia's energy and logistics infrastructure, provoking Russian export controls and supply shifts while raising regional security risks and straining international sanctions politics. These attacks create feedbacks across energy markets, fuel supply chains, sanctions implementation, and alliance responses, producing humanitarian pressures in Ukraine and diplomatic incidents in neighbouring states. The system is open: military actions alter commercial flows and political support, which in turn reshape military options and economic countermeasures.
system_description.scope: The interactive system formed by the Russia–Ukraine conflict (military strikes, defense procurement, and civilian harm) and the immediate international responses that affect energy flows, sanctions policy, regional security incidents, and humanitarian relief.
system_description.super_system: Global political-economic and security architecture (energy markets, international trade, alliance diplomacy, and norms against cross-border escalation).
adjacent_subsystems: European energy markets and supply chains
Global commodity and shipping networks (oil, diesel, grain)
Domestic political processes shaping sanctions and military aid (US, EU, Russia, Ukraine)

variables.name: Military strike frequency
variables.description: The rate and intensity at which kinetic attacks are conducted against infrastructure and territory within the operational theatre.

variables.name: Strike targeting accuracy
variables.description: The precision with which kinetic effects hit intended military or dual-use targets versus unintended civilian or collateral targets.

variables.name: Energy infrastructure operational capacity
variables.description: The proportion of energy production, refining, storage and transmission capacity that is functional and available for use.

variables.name: Fuel supply flow
variables.description: The volume and continuity of liquid fuels and related energy commodities moving through commercial supply chains to end users and markets.

variables.name: Export control intensity
variables.description: The strictness and restrictiveness of export limitations applied to energy and strategic goods that affect cross-border trade volumes.

variables.name: Sanctions enforcement effectiveness
variables.description: The operational effectiveness of measures intended to inhibit targeted economic activity, including detection, interdiction and compliance rates.

variables.name: Sanctions political cohesion
variables.description: The degree of alignment and sustained agreement among sanctioning actors on objectives, scope and duration of restrictive measures.

variables.name: Supply chain resilience
variables.description: The ability of logistical and commercial networks to adapt, reroute and maintain flows in the face of disruptions to sources or nodes.

variables.name: Logistics network integrity
variables.description: The functional condition of transport and storage infrastructure and services that enable movement of goods and fuel.

variables.name: Energy market price volatility
variables.description: The short- and medium-term variability in energy commodity prices driven by supply disruptions, demand shifts and policy changes.

variables.name: Cross-border incident risk
variables.description: The probability and expected severity of military or accidental incidents that extend operations or impacts across international borders.

variables.name: Arms procurement rate
variables.description: The tempo and volume at which defensive and offensive military capabilities are being acquired, delivered and fielded.

variables.name: Repair and reconstruction capacity
variables.description: The available technical, material and logistical resources and throughput to restore damaged infrastructure and services.

variables.name: Humanitarian need level
variables.description: The aggregate scale and severity of civilian needs for food, shelter, medical care and basic services arising from conflict disruption.

variables.name: Civilian displacement rate
variables.description: The rate at which civilian populations are uprooted from homes and communities and require relocation or shelter assistance.

variables.name: Alliance political support level
variables.description: The aggregated intensity of political, diplomatic and expressed policy support provided by external partners to actors in the conflict environment.

catalysts.title: Ukraine adapts strikes on critical energy components
catalysts.description: Continued Ukrainian campaign to target refinery and critical energy components in Russia, shifting to more disabling strikes on dual-use infrastructure.
catalysts.rationale: Based on FT: "Ukraine adapts strikes on Russian energy industry to hit critical components" and repeated refinery-targeting headlines.

catalysts.title: Russia's diesel/gasoline export ban through Jan 2027
catalysts.description: Moscow's extended ban on diesel and gasoline exports remains in force, constraining cross-border fuel flows until the stated end-date.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "Russia extends diesel, gasoline export bans until end of January 2027."

catalysts.title: US advances new Russia sanctions package
catalysts.description: Legislative momentum in the US to approve a new sanctions package targeting Russia, likely increasing enforcement and export restrictions.
catalysts.rationale: From headlines: "Large majority of US Senate votes to advance Russia sanctions" and "US poised to impose new Russia sanctions package."

catalysts.title: Erosion of EU political cohesion on new Russia sanctions
catalysts.description: Signs of weakening EU political agreement and carve-outs for shipping may reduce the scope and durability of new EU measures against Russia.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "EU faces crumbling support for new Russia sanctions" and "Greek shipping carve-out prompts EU rethink."

catalysts.title: Kazakhstan talks to process Russian crude
catalysts.description: Negotiations to route and process Russian crude in Kazakhstan could re-route supply chains and partially offset Russian refinery shortfalls.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "Kazakhstan in talks to process Russian crude amid Russia fuel shortages."

catalysts.title: Russia imports fuel from India to replace lost refining capacity
catalysts.description: Moscow sourcing incremental fuel from India to cover shortages caused by refinery damage, altering trade flows and inventories.
catalysts.rationale: FT: "Russia forced to import fuel from India as Ukrainian strikes damage refineries."

catalysts.title: Cross-border missile incidents and Polish military/diplomatic responses
catalysts.description: Missile debris and incidents in Poland trigger military scrambles and diplomatic protests, raising risk of wider cross-border escalation.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Polish police find crater..."; "Poland summons Russian ambassador"; fighters scrambled after missile incident.

catalysts.title: Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy and civilian sites escalate
catalysts.description: Sustained Russian missile and air attacks targeting Ukrainian energy, petrol stations and civilian areas increase humanitarian pressure and infrastructure losses.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Russia targets hundreds of Ukrainian petrol stations" and multiple reports of Russian bombardment killing civilians.

catalysts.title: Ukraine continues strikes on Russian commercial/logistics assets
catalysts.description: Attacks on warehouses and commercial logistics (eg. Wildberries) degrade Russian distribution networks and commercial assets, provoking political backlash.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Ukraine strikes two more warehouses of Russian online retailer Wildberries" and owner calls attacks 'acts of terrorism.'

catalysts.title: Procurement reforms disrupt Ukrainian arms procurement tempo
catalysts.description: Internal procurement reforms and associated leadership changes may slow or reconfigure defense procurement and deliveries in near term.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Ukraine's ex-defence minister says changes to military procurements behind his dismissal."
